verdict.rationale: The evidence shows cloud-platform authentication only for model access: customers can route chat models through Azure OpenAI or AWS Bedrock using access keys or IAM roles. Enterprise service accounts add non-personal credentials with key rotation and an audit trail. Nothing shows users signing in to Cursor through an enterprise identity provider, and the BYO-key path excludes Tab completion. Missing for 10: documented SSO/SAML/OIDC user login, SCIM provisioning, cloud-platform auth covering all models including Tab, and independent corroboration.
